title: Checksummed migrations + money/UTC helpers
summary: Desktop boots with MigrationRunner and migrations 0002–0015 (core shop), integer cents, and UTC helpers. Odysseus install only touches an empty sysforge.db with no schema, no money helpers, and no checksum policy. Port append-only migrations, SchemaVersion, Money/UTC round-trip helpers, and async DB APIs from day one.

title: Business dashboard shell + inner router
summary: Desktop opens a full sidebar, dashboard cards, view cache, and back stack. Odysseus opens a gated stub modal with status copy only. Replace the stub with a Business dashboard (Calculator / Clients / Drafts / Parts cards) and router.js multi-view navigation while keeping the feature-flag install gate.

title: Clients CRUD, FTS5 search, duplicate warnings
summary: Desktop has full client CRUD, Lucene typeahead, and non-blocking DB-12 duplicate warnings (Use existing / Create anyway). Odysseus has no clients API or UI. Port CRUD + FTS5 typeahead (matches before Add New, debounce/abort) and soft duplicate warnings; defer merge tool.

title: Parts catalog + placeholder create/merge
summary: Desktop supports parts CRUD, SQL LIKE search, placeholder creation on save, and irreversible placeholder merge with confirm. Odysseus has none of this. Port parts API/UI, placeholder create on invoice save, and merge UI with confirm; keep Lucene parts and supplier detail UX for later.

title: File drafts service, list UI, calculator autosave
summary: Desktop uses JSON file drafts with triple-buffer autosave, drafts list, and name dialog. Odysseus only mkdirs drafts/. Port file-based DraftService (debounce, concurrency lock, atomic write, leave-page flush), list + name UI, and calculator autosave integration. Keep DRAFT-08 retention default off and unwired until the safe-retention workstream.

title: Invoice calculator create/edit + save contracts
summary: Desktop keyboard-first calculator supports create/edit, name prompt, same-id edit (preserve status/finalized/sent_at), save-as-new clone, placeholder orphan cleanup after re-insert, create ≥1 line / edit may be empty, busy flags, and enum/JSON money helpers. Odysseus has no calculator. Port the full MVP calculator loop with those contracts; viewer return nav is a follow-on.

title: Business settings UI (tax/currency/autosave)
summary: Desktop has a Settings window for tax, shipping, drafts, and backup. Odysseus writes a minimal config.json on install with no UI. Add in-app Business settings for tax_rate_bps, currency, and autosave so daily use does not require editing JSON on disk.

title: Nav lifecycle + View/Edit route contracts
summary: Desktop requires single-writer / detach-on-reference-change for active panel (duplicate CurrentView assign killed CardClicked), and View/Edit must navigate visibly (not only fill calculator state). Port these as shell router contracts: dashboard cards stay live after cache re-select; View opens read-only route; Edit loads and navigates to calculator.

title: Classic four-column Client Dashboard
summary: Desktop production default is Classic four-column: invoice rail | preview | projects | client edit, with compact search overlay (empty → recent 6, clear ≠ deselect, no auto-open when query == selected name, keyboard nav), inline Address/Notes. Odysseus has no client workspace. Port Classic only (retire Onboard/Preview+/etc.); session recent-6 OK; persistent MRU optional later.

title: Invoice viewer + save-as-new return context
summary: Desktop save-as-new goes name dialog → new id → viewer → Back to Client Dashboard with client selected and list refresh; viewer Edit returns to calculator with captured origin. Odysseus has no viewer or back-stack. Port read-only viewer, price-compare (desktop Done), and return-context / history trim so the post-save loop matches desktop.

title: Projects, work orders, create-from-invoice
summary: Desktop has schema 0016–0018, acceptance → WO, create-from-invoice (shared picker path, blank device ID refused), projects hub, and four-column project detail as the only detail route (scroll view retired). Odysseus has none. Port migrations + services + hub + four-column detail + Classic projects column; defer P4 rich notes / P6 inventory / DisplayCode.

title: Plugin backup/restore + BUG-018 reindex
summary: Desktop Settings backup/restore and scheduled backups are Done; BUG-018 requires client search rebuild after every bulk import path, including skip-all. Odysseus only mkdirs backups/ and has no plugin-scoped restore or reindex. Port plugin ZIP/JSON backup/restore, wire reindex on all import/restore paths, and treat Diagnostics list ≠ search proof. Per-invoice restore UI and Q-05 leftovers can ship in the same surface or as thin follow-ups.

title: Read-only Business diagnostics panel
summary: Desktop Diagnostics shows migration version and DB health. Odysseus has no plugin diagnostics. Add a read-only panel (schema version, DB path/health) that never leaks secrets on multi-user paths; include archive-search / don't-ask-again only if projects settings land in the same pass.

title: Optional DRAFT-08 retention (safe defaults)
summary: Desktop DeleteOldDrafts exists but is intentionally unwired (silent delete risk). Odysseus must not auto-purge on plugin load by default. Add opt-in retention (settings + warn/pin) via user action or scheduler; never silent startup delete.

title: Screw maps S0–S2 annotate workspace
summary: Desktop is in progress on migrations 0019–0021, ScrewMapService, and ScrewMapView (single-click place, numbered dots, autosave+undo, HW/Other only, 1:1 map/project, preview above Before/After). Odysseus has nothing. Port schema + image store under plugin data + HTML canvas/SVG ScrewMapView; defer S5 mobile, zoom/pan extras, and repair timeline.

title: Parts FTS, suppliers UX, price history, triage
summary: Desktop still uses SQL LIKE for parts; Lucene parts, supplier preferred UX, price history, and placeholder triage queue are Planned. After MVP parts+merge, deepen search (FTS5), supplier autocomplete/preferred, price history + update preview, and triage queue beyond merge.
source_refs: future-plans-roadmap §4.1 Lucene parts / triage / price history

title: Client MRU, shortcuts, Future UI shell polish
summary: Desktop defers persistent client MRU (LastInteractedAt / recent 6), nav history across restart, Future UI Phase 2–3 (shortcuts, favorites, themes, breadcrumbs). Odysseus should reuse host shortcuts/themes rather than dual systems. Plan as post-core polish once Classic and invoice loops work.

title: Invoice v3+ PDF/email/payments + client merge
summary: Desktop Invoice-Roadmap v3+ covers PDF, email, payments, reporting, roles; DB-12 client merge remains Deferred after detect-only. Out of parity MVP. Track as a later ops/paperwork epic after shop flow and backup are solid.
